plugins.name: agentrmc-bridge
plugins.description: AgentRMC pet bridge for ZCode: auto bubble alerts on permission/task completion via hooks, plus MCP tools to report progress, make the pet speak and query pet state.

description_i18n.zh-CN: AgentRMC 桌宠联动：权限确认/任务完成自动气泡提醒（hooks），MCP 工具汇报进度、让桌宠说话、查桌宠状态。
